provenance.universe_definition: Liquidity-screened NSE equity universe. Membership on date D requires: listed on or before D (NSE DATE OF LISTING and first observed bar), still trading on D (series has not ended), trailing 60-session average volume >= 500,000 shares AND average turnover >= Rs 5,000,000, and price >= Rs 5.0.

universe_manifest.definition: Liquidity-screened NSE equity universe. Membership on date D requires: listed on or before D (NSE DATE OF LISTING and first observed bar), still trading on D (series has not ended), trailing 60-session average volume >= 500,000 shares AND average turnover >= Rs 5,000,000, and price >= Rs 5.0.
universe_manifest.not_index_membership: Deliberately NOT the NIFTY 500. NSE serves no dated historical constituent files, so index membership cannot be established point-in-time and is not inferred.

pool_completeness.limitation: Counts only names present in the pool. Companies that delisted before NSE's current equity list was published are absent from it entirely and cannot be counted here.

criteria.name: oos_sharpe
criteria.detail: Walk-forward out-of-sample Sharpe, net of costs.

criteria.name: bootstrap_lower_bound
criteria.detail: 5th percentile of the stationary-bootstrap Sharpe distribution.

criteria.name: deflated_sharpe
criteria.detail: P(true Sharpe > 0) after deflating for 6 trials.

criteria.name: pbo
criteria.detail: Probability the in-sample winner underperforms out-of-sample.

criteria.name: excess_cagr_vs_benchmark
criteria.detail: Out-of-sample CAGR minus benchmark CAGR over the same dates.

criteria.name: consistent_across_years
criteria.detail: Fraction of out-of-sample years with positive excess return.

criteria.name: point_in_time_universe
criteria.detail: A universe that excludes delisted companies cannot support a validation claim, however strong the statistics computed on it.

limitations: POINT-IN-TIME UNIVERSE APPLIED: membership on each date requires the symbol to have been listed, still trading, and liquid over the trailing window on that date. 1 of 946 pool symbols (0.11%) stopped trading during the period and are excluded from dates after they stopped, so companies that failed are held for exactly the period they were tradeable.

RESIDUAL POOL BIAS: NSE's equity list contains only companies listed TODAY, so companies that delisted before it was published are absent unless added by name. The universe definition is point-in-time; the POOL it draws from is still incomplete by an unmeasured amount.
Sector labels are current, not point-in-time; reclassified companies carry today's label backwards.
NOT AVAILABLE — No intraday feed is available. The vendor serves daily bars only, so no intraday strategy can be researched or validated here.

NOT AVAILABLE — No corporate-action dataset with ex-dates, split ratios or dividend amounts is available. Splits and dividends are only implicit in the vendor's adj_close, which is sufficient for computing returns and insufficient for anything that needs the event itself.

NOT AVAILABLE — No fundamentals source with PUBLICATION dates is available. Fundamentals indexed by fiscal period end embed look-ahead bias, so value and quality factors cannot be validly researched here.

12 requested symbols returned no data and are absent from the study (ADANIGAS, ADANITRANS, GRUH, HDFC, HEXAWARE, LTIM, MASTECH, MCDOWELL-N...). Several are renamed or merged tickers, which is direct evidence of the symbol-change gap rather than a transient fetch error.
